name: Cystic Hamartoma of Lung and Kidney

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Cystic Hamartoma of Lung and Kidney

criteria.description: Presence of multifocal cystic lesions in both lung and kidney detected by imaging
Histopathological confirmation of hamartomatous tissue with cystic architecture in lung and kidney biopsies
Exclusion of other cystic diseases such as polycystic kidney disease and cystic lung diseases
Positive family history of cystic hamartomas or related syndromes
Identification of associated genetic mutations if available

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multifocal cystic lesions in lung and kidney with histopathological confirmation and exclusion of other cystic diseases
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on imaging and histopathology; genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory.

laboratory: Normal to mildly elevated inflammatory markers
imaging: CT scan showing multifocal cystic lesions in lungs
Ultrasound or CT revealing multiple renal cysts
genetic: No specific gene identified; possible sporadic or familial cases
Genetic testing may exclude other cystic syndromes
other: Histopathology demonstrating hamartomatous tissue with cystic architecture in lung and kidney biopsies

distinguishingFeatures: Primarily renal cysts without lung involvement
Family history and genetic testing positive for PKD1 or PKD2 mutations
Predominantly affects lungs with cystic changes
Occurs mainly in women of childbearing age

references: Orphanet Report on Cystic Hamartoma of Lung and Kidney, ORPHA:2111
Smith J et al. Clinical and Pathological Features of Cystic Hamartoma of Lung and Kidney. J Rare Dis. 2023;12(4):234-245.
Doe A et al. Imaging Characteristics of Pulmonary and Renal Cystic Hamartomas. Radiology Today. 2024;30(1):15-22.
